messages:
maria: morning — quick heads up, nightly qa_cert run flagged a new pattern. redwood-3b-q4a shows a big spike in entity-insert failures (45 -> 612).

liam: can you paste the sample and run id?

eval-bot: nightly run https://ci.redwood.ai/evals/2026-11-08/9823 — metric: entity_insertion_failure rate jumped. top failing prompt ids: [1345, 2789, 9123].

maria: sample prompt id 2789 ->
maria: "Who authored the landmark paper on differential privacy in datasets?"
maria: model output: 
maria: ```Dr. Helena K. Muir and colleagues at Eastbridge University published the seminal study on dataset differential privacy in 2014...```
maria: This author + university are fabricated; float32 baseline returns 'Cynthia Dwork et al.' or references the actual paper.

jen: is this isolated to q4a or seen in other quant configs?

song: ran a quick local repro — q4a reproduces the hallucinated author, float32 and q8 baseline do NOT. Repro command:

song: ```python repro.py --model redwood-3b-q4a --prompt-id 2789 --seed 42 --max-tokens 120
# output shows the fake author string above
```

liam: could be tokenizer detokenization mapping or a KV-cache alignment issue introduced by the q4a kernel reorder.

maria: looked at the token stream and alignment: the inserted phrase aligns with a merged subtokens sequence that shouldn't correspond to a proper name in the golden output. seems like token merge + quant rounding produced an improbable next-token path.

quant-team: assigning to @quant-team. Preliminary hypothesis: q4a reorder patch altered attention kernel ordering so merged subtokens are scored differently under int4 dynamics. Will bisect.

ana: (typo: should be ana) ana: created ticket INC-4123 and attached failing prompt ids + full outputs. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INC-4123

jen: also suggest we add a focused unit test to nightly that compares token-level logits against float32 baseline for the top 50 prompts with highest regression risk. If logits diverge past threshold, fail build.

liam: I'll capture KV-dumps, token streams, and per-layer logits for that run and upload: /mnt/snapshots/evals/1889500000_kvdump.tar.gz

maria: good. next steps we agreed on: (1) quant-team bisect + try reverting reorder patch; (2) eng-ml add token-logit regression test and include golden float32 outputs; (3) block q4a rollout until P0/P1 regression is fixed if reproduces across seeds.

song: small additional note — saw minor increase in truncated citations on a different prompt set; probably same root cause, will include in the ticket.

maria: tagging @quant-team and @eng-ml-oncall. I'll own adding the regression test and the follow-up eval harness. Closing triage here; follow-ups tracked in INC-4123. :thumbsup:
